description: Check a Powerball or Mega Millions ticket against the latest draw or a given draw date: which numbers matched, the prize tier, the prize amount (with Power Play, or with the multiplier printed on a Mega Millions ticket) and the odds of that tier. Optional Powerball Double Play matches.

date.description: Draw date on the ticket, YYYY-MM-DD. Default the latest draw.

double_play.description: Powerball: also check the Double Play drawing.

multiplier.description: Mega Millions: the multiplier printed on the ticket (2, 3, 4, 5 or 10).

numbers.description: The 5 white-ball numbers on the ticket.

power_play.description: Powerball: the ticket has Power Play.

special.description: The Powerball (1-26) or Mega Ball (1-24) on the ticket.

name: lottery_check_ticket
title: Check a lottery ticket
